appDescription: A driving partner app that reads vehicle data and guides the driver step by step through situations such as parking, tire warnings and accidents, then confirms each action with vehicle data.

function.name: CHECK_PARKING_SAFETY
function.description: Start voice guidance that checks the parked car is secured, including the parking brake and the steering direction on a slope.

function.name: EXPLAIN_TIRE_WARNING
function.description: Start voice guidance about a tire pressure warning, telling the driver how to stop safely and what to check at a repair shop.
